Class LogCaptorAssert

java.lang.Object

org.assertj.core.api.AbstractObjectAssert<LogCaptorAssert, nl.altindag.log.LogCaptor>
nl.pim16aap2.testing.assertions.LogCaptorAssert
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.assertj.core.api.Assert<LogCaptorAssert, nl.altindag.log.LogCaptor>, org.assertj.core.api.Descriptable<LogCaptorAssert>, org.assertj.core.api.ExtensionPoints<LogCaptorAssert, nl.altindag.log.LogCaptor>
@NullMarked public class LogCaptorAssert extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractObjectAssert<LogCaptorAssert, nl.altindag.log.LogCaptor>
An assertion class for LogCaptor instances.

This class provides methods to assert various conditions on the logs captured by a LogCaptor. It extends AbstractAssert from AssertJ to provide fluent assertions.
